request.system_purpose: Rank resumes stored in SharePoint and recommend a shortlist to recruiters.
request.human_review_process: Recruiters review ranked recommendations before hiring decisions.

manual_review_criteria: Review fairness, privacy, access trimming and meaningful human review; do not invent legal applicability.

request.system_purpose: Read synthetic Sentinel incidents and Defender telemetry and propose investigation steps.
request.human_review_process: Analyst reviews every recommendation. No write capability.

manual_review_criteria: Preserve untrusted telemetry boundaries and recommendation-only action limits.

request.system_purpose: An agent reads incident evidence and may trigger Logic Apps to disable an account using Graph.
request.human_review_process: A responder approves each target and action before execution.
request.business_impact: Incorrect disablement could interrupt critical operations.

manual_review_criteria: Examine approval binding, least privilege, reversibility and failure behavior; proposed capabilities are not performed actions.

request.system_purpose: A third-party assistant plugin receives excerpts from internal SharePoint documents.
request.human_review_process: Users see generated responses; no disclosure approval process is defined.

manual_review_criteria: Identify recipient retention, onward sharing, minimization and missing disclosure authorization.

request.system_purpose: Answer questions using approved nonsensitive internal FAQ documents; no action tools.
request.human_review_process: Users can report incorrect answers to the document owner.
request.business_impact: Low operational impact; users consult official pages for decisions.

manual_review_criteria: Recognize bounded read-only use, proportionate controls and residual accuracy/access concerns without automatic critical risk.

request.system_purpose: The system always requires human approval before action. It also automatically disables accounts immediately before any human can review.
request.human_review_process: Mandatory prior human approval; automatic action occurs first.

manual_review_criteria: Preserve the contradictory claims, request clarification and do not treat the asserted review as an effective gate.
